text: A new person can't do anything in Scout until they have a role. Here's how to give one, for one office or the whole practice.
The one thing to remember: techs, vets and inventory managers get their role per office. Tick the office they work at.
Sam Chen is our new tech.
Open his Access tab.
He can't do anything yet. He has no role.
Roles are given on the Roles page. Open the Staff menu,
and choose Roles.
Pick the role: Technician.
Technician is a per-office role, so there's a list for each office.
Sam works out of Raleigh, so tick him there.
And save.
The change is logged right here, with who made it.
His office decides which stock he can count and move, and which office's automatic tasks he gets.
Someone who works at both offices is ticked under both.
Like Dr. Riley Rivera, a veterinarian at Raleigh and at Durham.
Now back to the Staff menu,
and Staff.
Pick Sam again,
and open Access.
He now has everything a technician needs.
On his Profile tab, Raleigh is now his default office too. Scout set it from his role, because he didn't have one. Checkout takes his stock from there.
Practice-wide roles, like Client Liaison or Lead Technician, can also be ticked here on the Profile tab.
The most common mistakes: ticking a tech under the wrong office, so their stock and tasks go to the wrong place, and forgetting the second office for someone who works at both.
Remember: techs, vets and inventory managers get their role per office. Tick the office they work at.
